page: Google Cloud Platform z4d-highmem-48-highlssd is a storage-optimized virtual machine belonging to the z4d server family. It features 48 dedicated vCPUs built on the x86_64 architecture. The system is equipped with 378.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 7.88 GB of RAM per core.

This configuration includes 22549 GB of local storage distributed across six NVMe SSDs. There are no integrated GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses bundled with this instance type. The massive local storage capacity is designed for high-throughput, low-latency data access directly on the host.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the instance offers high resource density, combining substantial memory capacity with a very large local NVMe storage footprint. This hardware profile is designed for workloads requiring significant local storage capacity and memory, such as large-scale databases, data warehousing, and transactional processing systems.
